task_completion.description: Open UGENE and load the human insulin gene GenBank file and the primer text file.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The UGENE interface is visible with 'human_insulin_gene.gb' and 'pcr_primers.txt' listed in the Project View or opened in the sequence view.

task_completion.description: Configure the In Silico PCR dialog with 0 mismatches and a maximum product size of 1000 bp.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'In Silico PCR' dialog box is visible with 'Mismatches' set to 0 and 'Maximum product size' set to 1000.

task_completion.description: Run the PCR simulation and identify the resulting amplicon.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The PCR results panel or a new sequence object showing a predicted PCR product (amplicon) is visible within UGENE.

task_completion.description: Export the predicted amplicon sequence to the specified FASTA file.
task_completion.visual_evidence: An export dialog or a file browser shows the amplicon being saved to '~/UGENE_Data/pcr_results/amplicon.fasta'.

task_completion.description: Export the annotated gene with the PCR product to the specified GenBank file.
task_completion.visual_evidence: An export dialog or file browser shows the annotated sequence being saved to '~/UGENE_Data/pcr_results/insulin_pcr_annotated.gb'.

task_completion.description: Create a text report documenting the primer sequences, amplification status, positions, length, and suitability.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor (like Gedit or LibreOffice) is open showing 'pcr_validation_report.txt' containing the required data: primer sequences, start/end positions, and a conclusion.

integrity.description: Verify the agent used the UGENE GUI for the PCR simulation rather than just command-line scripts.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the agent interacting with UGENE menus, dialog boxes, and sequence views.

integrity.description: Ensure the PCR results were generated by the software, not manually typed into the report from external knowledge.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the 'In Silico PCR' results list or the highlighted region on the insulin gene sequence before the report is written.

integrity.description: Check that the agent is saving files to the specific 'pcr_results' subdirectory as instructed.
integrity.visual_evidence: The file paths in the 'Save As' dialogs or terminal 'ls' commands match '~/UGENE_Data/pcr_results/'.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The input files are located at /home/ga/UGENE_Data/human_insulin_gene.gb and /home/ga/UGENE_Data/pcr_primers.txt. The PCR simulation must be set to 0 mismatches and 1000bp max size. The output files must be saved in /home/ga/UGENE_Data/pcr_results/. The report must explicitly state the start/end positions and length of the amplicon found during the UGENE simulation.
